title: 600 diseases in 600k individuals: phenotype associations
bodyHtml:
This page displays gene-level associations for the phenotype you have chosen.

Note that the search results may take a few seconds to load.

The Manhattan plot displays the chromosomal locations of genes associated with the phenotype. Mouse over the plot to see gene names, coordinates, and p-values.

The Q-Q plot displays the difference between the observed and expected p-values for each gene-level association. Mouse over the plot to see gene names, coordinates, and p-values.

Gene-level association scores calculated using three variant masks are available on the Gene page (click on a gene name to navigate to a Gene page).

dataTableLegendHtml:
Filter the table using the filters above:

  • Gene: type in a full or partial gene name and press "Return"
  • P-value: enter a value to set a lower threshold (examples: 5e-8, 0.001)

Click on a column header to sort the table by that column.
